name: AhaSlides
summary: Interactive presentation platform with live polls, quizzes, word clouds and audience Q&A, free for up to 50 participants.
best_for: educators, trainers and event hosts running interactive sessions (polls, quizzes, word clouds and live Q&A) with audiences up to 50 free
skip_if: you need predictable, uniform pricing across a multi-country team, or your decks live in PowerPoint and a lightweight poll add-on covers it
honest_knock: AhaSlides runs regional pricing: the number on the pricing page depends on where you browse from, so any review quoting one price (including ours) may not match yours. The advertised savings assume annual commitment, and the free tier's five-quiz-slide cap nudges real quiz use toward paid.

pricing.entry_price_terms: a month billed yearly (NL price - varies by country)
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-09-06 and again 2026-09-30) AhaSlides prices regionally, so the currency and the amount depend on where you buy from; the figures below are the reading from a Netherlands location on 6 September 2026, and your own country's page may show a different rate for the same tier. Free is 0 for up to 50 participants, with unlimited events and unlimited presentations but only 2 question types per presentation (as of 22 November 2026). Essential is €7.25 per month billed yearly and lifts the ceiling to 100 participants, adding unlimited interactive slides, analytics and exports, and folder management. Pro AI is €10.65 per month billed yearly, raises the ceiling to 2,500 participants and adds the AI features, custom branding, Q&A moderation and priority support. Enterprise is quote-only, listed at up to 100,000 participants with SSO and SCIM offered on demand. Two discounts sit on top: yearly billing is advertised at up to 67% below monthly, and team licences bought together save up to a further 20%. AhaSlides' own USD listing puts Essential at $95.40 a year, which is the same tier at a different regional price rather than a second plan — so check the page from your own country before you budget. Read again from the same Netherlands location on 30 September 2026, both yearly rates were unchanged, and the monthly toggle showed what the yearly discount is measured against: €22.75 a month for Essential and €46.75 for Pro AI. The team calculator's default of 3 Pro AI licences on yearly billing came to €345.06 a year instead of €383.40, a 10% saving (it takes 2 to 30 licences). Each paid card carries a 100% money-back guarantee line.

sessions.what: Our AI assistant ran the test on 22 November 2026 in the AhaSlides web app on a free account, with the interface in English. We let it build a starter quiz, added slides until the free plan stopped us, presented the quiz, joined it as a participant from a second browser tab and answered, then read the session report and the upgrade options. We paid nothing.
findings: Start: after two questions about how we would use it, choosing Quiz built a sample physics quiz with three Pick Answer questions and a leaderboard.

Free limit: when we added a True or False slide and two Open Ended slides, crowns appeared on the slides and the tooltip read Free plan: 2 question types per presentation. Present then showed Too many question types for Free and asked us to remove one type or upgrade.

Live session: after we removed the Open Ended slides, Present showed a join link and QR code. Joining from a second tab needed only a name and an emoji, with no app or account, and took about 17 seconds. The join page had filled in the first name of the logged in presenter, because both tabs ran in the same browser; we changed it.
Answering: after Start the question appeared on the participant screen; our answer was marked Correct with 69 points, and the presenter chart showed 1 vote and 1 of 50 participants.
Report: the session report showed 1 participant, 1 submission and 100% accuracy. Export to Excel, PDF or images was marked as a paid feature.

Prices on 22 November 2026: the pricing page listed Free with 50 participants and 2 question types per presentation, Essential at EUR 7.25 and Pro at EUR 10.65 a month billed yearly. The upgrade dialog in the app showed Pro at EUR 46.75 billed monthly.
not_tested: a real class: we joined as one participant from a second browser tab, so the 50 participant limit and a busy room were not tested
the AI slide generator, PowerPoint and PDF import, and the Zoom, Teams and Google Slides integrations
self paced mode, team play and Q&A
the paid plans: we opened the upgrade dialog and pricing page to read the prices and did not buy
